def transform(grid):
    # The grid is a 3x3 arrangement of 4x4-pattern tiles. Rows/columns 4 and 9
    # delimit the upper tile band; a solid color-3 band separates top/bottom.
    # For each 4x4 tile, color its top-rightmost occupied cell(s) 8; others stay 2.

    for tr in (0,1,3):
